approvedSourceOfTruthDecisions.topic: Rental facts row — Phòng ngủ / Nội thất
approvedSourceOfTruthDecisions.decision: Facts row shows Diện tích/Phòng ngủ/Thang máy/Nội thất on both viewports, matching the approved masters' visual slots exactly (the desktop render 03_ChiTietChoThue_WEB.png shows the same four slots as the mobile render). Phòng ngủ and Nội thất have no backing field in data-source-map.json's public schema, so they render "—" rather than being inferred from property_type, parsed from description, or fabricated in fixture data. Diện tích binds to `area`; Thang máy binds to real `vertical_access` data.
